providers.provider_name: Nevada Power Company dba NV Energy (Southern Nevada)
providers.service_territory: Southern Nevada including Las Vegas, Henderson, Boulder City, and surrounding communities
providers.notes: Subsidiary of NV Energy (Berkshire Hathaway Energy). Largest IOU in Nevada by customer count. Serves the Las Vegas metro. Regulated by PUCN under Tariff No. 1-B.

providers.provider_name: Sierra Pacific Power Company dba NV Energy (Northern Nevada)
providers.service_territory: Northern Nevada including Reno-Sparks, Elko, Winnemucca, Carson City, and surrounding communities
providers.notes: Subsidiary of NV Energy (Berkshire Hathaway Energy). Serves northern Nevada. Regulated by PUCN under Tariff No. Electric No. 1. Both NV Energy subsidiaries operate a unified commercial rebate portal at nvenergy.com/bes.

programs.provider_name: Nevada Power Company dba NV Energy (Southern Nevada)
programs.program_name: Business Energy Services – Sure Bet Prescriptive Retrofit (2025)
programs.stacking_rules: Cannot stack prescriptive and custom incentives for the same measure
programs.program_notes_ai: Known historically as the 'Sure Bet' program. Applications submitted via nvenergy.com/bes portal. Pre-notification required before project start. Final application must be submitted within 30 days of project completion or by November 15 of program year, whichever comes first. Post-inspection may be required for verification. Incentive payments are sent within 4–6 weeks from inspection completion and document approval. Eligible for existing-facility retrofit projects; excludes new construction, additions, first tenant improvements, and K-12/public university facilities. Covers lighting, HVAC, refrigeration, kitchen equipment, compressed air, motors, and more. Incentives can cover 30–70% of project cost on average.

programs.provider_name: Nevada Power Company dba NV Energy (Southern Nevada)
programs.program_name: Business Energy Services – Sure Bet Custom Retrofit (2025)
programs.stacking_rules: Custom incentives available for technologies not covered by prescriptive schedule. Cannot stack with prescriptive incentive for same measure.
programs.program_notes_ai: Custom measures are technologies not covered by the prescriptive measures schedule. Compensated at $0.10 per on-peak kWh saved annually and $0.05 per off-peak kWh saved annually (historical rate; verify current rates at nvenergy.com/bes). Pre-notification required before project start. Documentation of systems and energy savings must be provided. Third-party incentive payment option available — incentive can be paid directly to contractor or design firm to streamline billing. M&V may be required for selected projects.

programs.provider_name: Nevada Power Company dba NV Energy (Southern Nevada)
programs.program_name: Business Energy Services – New Construction Incentives (2025)
programs.program_notes_ai: Available for new construction, major renovation, and building addition projects. Must meet or exceed IECC 2018 code baseline (5% lower than IECC 2018). Applications submitted via nvenergy.com/bes portal. Covers efficiency measures incorporated into new commercial construction. K-12 public schools and public universities are directed to the Energy Smart Schools program instead. Mixed-use facilities where energy crosses commercial/residential may be eligible case-by-case.

programs.provider_name: Nevada Power Company dba NV Energy (Southern Nevada)
programs.program_name: Business Energy Services – Small Business Incentives (2025)
programs.program_notes_ai: For non-residential NV Energy customers with annual electricity usage below 400,000 kWh who have been in operation for a minimum of 12 months. Offering up to 50% higher rebates in 2025. Incentives can cover up to 90% of total project cost. New construction, additions, expansions, first tenant improvements, or change-in-building-function projects are not eligible. Covers interior/exterior lighting, kitchen equipment, and air-cooled HVAC units. Authorized contractors through NV Energy's Contractor Network can handle incentive paperwork and cover NV Energy's portion of the project payment at point of install. Incentive amounts depend on equipment type, building type, and hours of operation.

programs.provider_name: Nevada Power Company dba NV Energy (Southern Nevada)
programs.program_notes_ai: Dedicated program for K-12 public schools and universities to help them become more energy efficient. Public K-12 and universities are directed to this program rather than the standard Business Energy Services Sure Bet program. Private schools not receiving public funding may be eligible for standard BES.

programs.provider_name: Sierra Pacific Power Company dba NV Energy (Northern Nevada)
programs.program_name: Business Energy Services – Sure Bet Prescriptive Retrofit (2025)
programs.stacking_rules: Cannot stack prescriptive and custom incentives for same measure
programs.program_notes_ai: Same unified Sure Bet program structure as Southern Nevada but serving northern Nevada commercial electric customers (Reno-Sparks, Elko, Carson City, Winnemucca, etc.) and NV Energy commercial gas customers in the Reno-Sparks area. Pre-notification required before project start. Final application due within 30 days of completion or November 15, whichever is first. Incentive checks issued 4–6 weeks after field inspection completion and document approval. Prescriptive measures include lighting, refrigeration, commercial kitchen equipment, HVAC, VSD pumps and fans, compressed air, and more.

programs.provider_name: Sierra Pacific Power Company dba NV Energy (Northern Nevada)
programs.program_name: Business Energy Services – Sure Bet Custom Retrofit (2025)
programs.stacking_rules: Custom incentives for technologies not covered by prescriptive schedule. Cannot stack with prescriptive incentive for same measure.
programs.program_notes_ai: Covers technologies not on the prescriptive measures schedule. Custom incentive rate historically $0.10 per on-peak kWh saved annually and $0.05 per off-peak kWh saved annually; verify current rate at nvenergy.com/bes. Pre-notification required. Third-party incentive payment option available — incentive can be paid to contractor or design firm. Selected projects may be subject to independent M&V.

programs.provider_name: Sierra Pacific Power Company dba NV Energy (Northern Nevada)
programs.program_name: Business Energy Services – New Construction Incentives (2025)
programs.program_notes_ai: Available for new construction, major renovation, and building addition projects in northern Nevada. Must meet or exceed IECC 2018 baseline. Applications submitted at nvenergy.com/bes. Mixed-use facilities may be eligible on a case-by-case basis. K-12 and public universities use Energy Smart Schools program.

programs.provider_name: Sierra Pacific Power Company dba NV Energy (Northern Nevada)
programs.program_name: Business Energy Services – Small Business Incentives (2025)
programs.program_notes_ai: Same eligibility and structure as Southern Nevada small business program. Serving northern Nevada non-residential customers with annual usage below 400,000 kWh, in operation for at least 12 months. Up to 50% higher rebates in 2025. Incentives cover up to 90% of project cost. Authorized contractor network can handle paperwork and point-of-install payment. Excludes new construction, additions, and first tenant improvements.

rate_schedules.provider_name: Nevada Power Company dba NV Energy (Southern Nevada)
rate_schedules.description: Small commercial customers below demand threshold (~3,500 kWh/month). Flat energy rate applies to all kWh. Additional riders (DEAA, TRED, REPR, EE, NDPP, ESAP, UEC) apply on top of base rate. Basic Service Charge $25.50/month per meter.
rate_schedules.notes: Base energy charge only; bundled rate includes generation, transmission, and distribution. DEAA, TRED, REPR, EE, NDPP, ESAP, and UEC riders are added separately each billing period. Rate shown is base electric consumption charge; total effective rate is higher with riders included.

rate_schedules.provider_name: Nevada Power Company dba NV Energy (Southern Nevada)
rate_schedules.schedule_name: LGS-1 – Large General Service 1 (Medium Commercial with Demand)
rate_schedules.description: Medium commercial customers with metered demand, below LGS-2 threshold. TOU energy rates differentiated by summer on-peak, summer off-peak, and winter hours. Demand charge and Facilities Charge per kW apply. Basic Service Charge $25.50/month.
rate_schedules.notes: TOU periods: summer on-peak typically 1:01 PM–7:00 PM, June–September. Riders (DEAA, TRED, REPR, EE, NDPP, ESAP, UEC, EVCCR) apply. Customers with ~1 MW+ may qualify for competitive procurement under NAC 704B. Specific $/kWh and $/kW values are quarterly-adjusted — see source PDF for current quarter rates.

rate_schedules.provider_name: Nevada Power Company dba NV Energy (Southern Nevada)
rate_schedules.schedule_name: LGS-2 – Large General Service 2 (Large Commercial with Demand)
rate_schedules.description: Large commercial customers with substantial metered demand. Summer on-peak demand charge up to $12.81/kW. Basic Service Charge $182.00/month. Per additional meter $123.25/month. Facilities Charge per kW applies. TOU energy rates vary by summer on-peak, summer off-peak, and winter periods.
rate_schedules.notes: Summer on-peak demand charge of $12.81/kW is the dominant cost driver per Nectar rate analysis. Riders (DEAA, TRED, REPR, EE, NDPP, ESAP, UEC, EVCCR) apply. Demand charge shown is approximate summer on-peak figure from third-party rate analysis; verify with current PUCN-filed tariff at nvenergy.com/rates.

rate_schedules.provider_name: Nevada Power Company dba NV Energy (Southern Nevada)
rate_schedules.schedule_name: LGS-3 – Large General Service 3 (Industrial/Very Large Commercial)
rate_schedules.description: Very large commercial/industrial customers. Summer on-peak demand charge up to $13.61/kW. TOU energy rates for summer on-peak, summer off-peak, and all winter hours. Facilities Charge per kW applies.
rate_schedules.notes: Highest demand charge tier in southern Nevada commercial schedule. Customers with ~1 MW+ load may evaluate 704B exit from bundled service. Specific $/kWh energy rates are quarterly-adjusted. Verify with current PUCN-filed tariff.

rate_schedules.provider_name: Nevada Power Company dba NV Energy (Southern Nevada)
rate_schedules.schedule_name: GS-TOU – General Service Time-of-Use (Optional Small Commercial TOU)
rate_schedules.description: Optional TOU rate for GS-1 customers who request time-of-use billing. TOU energy differentiated by summer on-peak, summer off-peak, and all winter hours.
rate_schedules.notes: Available to GS customers who opt into TOU pricing. Certain restrictions apply. Riders (DEAA, TRED, REPR, EE, NDPP, ESAP, UEC) apply in addition to TOU energy charges.

rate_schedules.provider_name: Nevada Power Company dba NV Energy (Southern Nevada)
rate_schedules.description: Closed rate schedule for existing outdoor/street lighting service customers only. No new applications accepted. Rates are fixed per lamp/luminaire for existing customers.
rate_schedules.notes: This schedule was closed to new customers by PUCN order. Existing OLS customers continue to be billed under the existing outdoor lighting service rates. New outdoor lighting customers must use applicable commercial or municipal schedule.

rate_schedules.provider_name: Sierra Pacific Power Company dba NV Energy (Northern Nevada)
rate_schedules.description: Small commercial customers in northern Nevada below the demand threshold. Flat energy rate; no demand charge. Basic Service Charge $35.75/month. Riders (DEAA, NDPP, ESAP, ESER, UEC) apply. DEAA currently $0.01029/kWh; UEC $0.00039/kWh.
rate_schedules.notes: Bundled rate includes generation, transmission, and distribution. ESER (Energy Storage and Electric Rate) rider at $0.03601/kWh also applies to northern Nevada schedules. Total effective rate is higher with all riders. Verify current base energy rate in PUCN-filed tariff at nvenergy.com/rates.

rate_schedules.provider_name: Sierra Pacific Power Company dba NV Energy (Northern Nevada)
rate_schedules.schedule_name: GS-2 – Medium General Service (Medium Commercial with Demand)
rate_schedules.description: Medium commercial customers in northern Nevada with metered demand. TOU energy charges for summer on-peak, summer mid-peak, summer off-peak, winter on-peak, winter mid-peak, and winter off-peak periods. Demand and Facilities Charges per kW apply.
rate_schedules.notes: Northern Nevada TOU schedule has more granular peak/mid-peak/off-peak periods than southern Nevada. Riders (DEAA $0.01029/kWh, NDPP, ESAP, ESER $0.03601/kWh, UEC $0.00039/kWh) apply. OGS-EVRR (EV rate rider) also available. Verify current $/kWh and $/kW in PUCN tariff.

rate_schedules.provider_name: Sierra Pacific Power Company dba NV Energy (Northern Nevada)
rate_schedules.description: Large commercial and industrial customers in northern Nevada. TOU energy rates for multiple peak periods plus Demand and Facilities Charges per kW. Highest commercial demand tier for Sierra Pacific.
rate_schedules.notes: Riders (DEAA, NDPP, ESAP, ESER, UEC) apply. Power factor adjustment at $0.0014/kVArh for kVArh exceeding 90% power factor equivalent. Very large customers may exit bundled service under NAC 704B. Verify current rates in PUCN tariff.

rate_schedules.provider_name: Sierra Pacific Power Company dba NV Energy (Northern Nevada)
rate_schedules.schedule_name: GS-1-TOU – Optional TOU for Small General Service
rate_schedules.description: Optional TOU rate available to GS-1 customers who request time-of-use billing. Summer on-peak, summer off-peak, and all winter hours differentiated. Basic Service Charge $35.75/month. OGS-EVRR (EV rate rider) also available.
rate_schedules.notes: Available to GS-1 customers in northern Nevada on request. Certain restrictions apply. Riders (DEAA $0.01029/kWh, UEC $0.00039/kWh, ESAP, NDPP, ESER $0.03601/kWh) apply on top of TOU energy rates.

rate_schedules.provider_name: Sierra Pacific Power Company dba NV Energy (Northern Nevada)
rate_schedules.description: Closed schedule for existing outdoor lighting service in northern Nevada. No new applications accepted per PUCN order. Existing customers billed at fixed per-luminaire rates.
rate_schedules.notes: Schedule was closed to new customers. Flat rates for existing OLS customers include DEAA $0.01029/kWh and UEC $0.00039/kWh, which are NOT included in the flat rates shown in the rate schedule (per tariff footnote).

rate_schedules.provider_name: Sierra Pacific Power Company dba NV Energy (Northern Nevada)
rate_schedules.description: Net metering rider for commercial customer-generators in northern Nevada under Assembly Bill 405 (2017). Initial fee per meter $52.44. Applicable to solar and other qualifying generation systems interconnected under Rule 15. TOU-based billing with Bulk Tariff General Rate (BTGR) credits. 80 MW statewide capacity allocation across Tranches 1, 2, and 3.
rate_schedules.notes: Effective for systems interconnected on or after October 1, 2025. Customer-generators receiving service under NMR-2025 are also subject to their otherwise applicable rate schedule. Standard form agreement required. Disposition of RECs specified in rider. Cannot simultaneously receive NMR-405 and NMR-2025. Customers must comply with Rule 15 interconnection requirements.
